brief:
The Arab American University launched its third international conference on digital transformation and artificial intelligence, Ma'an Wire reported. The event, titled "From Vision to Implementation: Promoting Artificial Intelligence Adoption in Education in Palestine," brings together stakeholders to discuss AI integration in the Palestinian education sector.

The conference addresses the practical application of digital technologies and artificial intelligence in educational institutions across Palestine, focusing on bridging the gap between strategic vision and on-the-ground implementation of AI-driven learning solutions.
